testCase.name: [dev] S22 Device-local copies of cleared data are gone too (web storage, native app storage)

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S22 「被清掉的数据在设备本地的副本也没了（网页存储、原生 app 存储）」 Device-local copies of cleared data are gone too (web storage, native app storage)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). …（UAT OAT-04 Expected 2；UAT 3.7 (retention claim)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Debug iOS and Android builds and the web app pointed at the local stack (Convex 4510, Vite 6473), one fresh @roundai.test account from freshAccount(); never the TestFlight / Play build, never the store-review fixed-code account. Each device used to dictate pre-round text and record vitals for a patient; …

When Inspect the app's local storage (web: localStorage / IndexedDB; native: app preferences and files) and reopen the app offline

Then No copy of the cleared values remains on the device or shows while offline

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-04 Expected 2. Whether device recovery drafts count as live data is Q6 (TFA-94745 left 'PHI at rest' open): a cleared value found on the device = Fail if device copies count, otherwise reported for Daniela

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
